parsed.reason: Direct answer to the question asked—takes a clear side ("I'd put it on pizza without apologizing") rather than dodging or sitting on the fence. Explains the reasoning briefly (sweet against salty), and acknowledges the other perspective without equivocating. No evasion, no invented specifics, no greeter fluff, no apps or websites, no apology for the take. Exactly what a sharp friend texts back on an opinion ask.
